'''Brigitta Pinkusovna Kovarskaia''' ({{Langx|ru|Бригитта Пинкусовна Коварская|'''Brigitta Pinkusovna Kovarskaya'''}}, [[née]] '''Orenstein'''; 7 March 1930 – 7 January 1998) was a [[Soviet Moldova|Soviet Moldovan]] physicist, computer scientist, educator, and local historian. 

== Life and career ==
Brigitta Kovarskaia was born as Brigitta Pinkusovna Orenstein on 7 March 1930, in Chișinău, [[Moldavian Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic]]. She was daughter of Blyuma Perezovna Manzovich, and the accountant Pinkus Abramovich Orenstein.<ref name="Kovarsky-2010">{{Cite web |last=Kovarsky |first=Evgeny V. |date=March 6, 2010 |title=80 - лет со дня рождения Бригитты Петровны Коварской (Оренштейн) |trans-title=80th anniversary of the birth of Brigitta Petrovna Kovarskaya (Orenstein) |url=http://kovarski.ru/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=109&Itemid=410 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160614185350/http://kovarski.ru/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=109&Itemid=410 |archive-date=June 14, 2016 |website=Kovarski.ru}}</ref> 

During [[German–Soviet War]] in World War II, Kovarskaia's maternal grandparents died in the [[Kishinev Ghetto]] (also known as Chișinău Ghetto), while Brigitta and her parents survived the war in the evacuation to [[Semipalatinsk]], and they returned to Chișinău in August 1944.

She studied at the faculty of physics and mathematics of the [[Moldova State University]] in Chișinău, and graduated in 1952.<ref name="Kovarsky-2010" /> She graduated from the PhD program in 1967, in the quantum chemistry department of the Moldova State University, majoring in "[[physical chemistry]]".<ref name="Technical University of Moldova-2015">{{Cite web |date=2015 |title=Br. Covarschi |url=http://fizica.utm.md/colaboratorii/au-activat/61-covarschi-b |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150703113103/http://fizica.utm.md/colaboratorii/au-activat/61-covarschi-b |archive-date=July 3, 2015 |website=Department of Physics of the Technical University of Moldova |language=Ro}}</ref>

She married the physicist {{Interlanguage link|Victor Kovarski|ro|Victor Kovarski}} in 1952, he was the son of {{Interlanguage link|Anatolie Kovarski|ro|Anatolie Kovarski}} a Soviet Moldovan academic in the field of plant selection and genetics.<ref name="Khazin-2013">{{Cite web |last=Khazin |first=Mikhail |date=February 3, 2013 |title=Костюжены. От князя Мирского к Гене Зингеру и Крушевану. Часть II |trans-title=Suited. From Prince Mirsky to Gena Singer and Krushevan. Part II |url=http://club.berkovich-zametki.com/?p=3106 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160614185402/http://club.berkovich-zametki.com/?p=3106 |archive-date=June 14, 2016 |website=Непрерывный (Continuous magazine) |language=ru}}</ref> They had two children, a son and a daughter.<ref name="Kovarsky-2010" /><ref name="Khazin-2013" />

From 1979 to 1985 Kovarskaia worked as a senior assistant in the department of informatics of the institute of mathematics of the [[Academy of Sciences of Moldova]], and from 1985 to 1998 as a senior assistant in the institute of history of the Academy of Sciences of Moldova.<ref name="Technical University of Moldova-2015" /><ref>{{Cite book |last=Б.П |first=Коварская |url=http://www.library.univ.kiev.ua/ukr/elcat/new/detail.php3?doc_id=836416 |title=Электронное строение и свойства плоскоквадратных комплексов Pt (2) |date=1969 |location=Вильнюс |trans-title=Electronic Structure and Properties of Square-Planar Pt (II) Complexes}}</ref>

In the 1990s, she published essays on the history of [[Bessarabian Jews]], including those from Chișinău.<ref name="Kovarsky-2010" /><ref name="Khazin-2013" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=January 7, 2004 |title=Memoria. Последний приют |trans-title=Memory: The last refuge |url=http://www.dorledor.info/node/6685 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160614185439/http://www.dorledor.info/node/6685 |archive-date=June 14, 2016 |website=Dorledor.info |language=ru}}</ref> Additionally she authored books on embroidery, knitting, and textbooks.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2014 |title=Биография Бригитты П.Коварской |trans-title=Biography of Brigitte P. Kowarska |url=http://kovarski.ru/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=43&Itemid=144 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160614185358/http://kovarski.ru/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=43&Itemid=144 |archive-date=June 14, 2016 |website=kovarski.ru |language=ru}}</ref>
